svg.title: Redistribute first, then trade
svg.desc: At the fixed target prices (1,1), Alice's budget before the transfer is x1A+x2A=6 through omega=(4,2). After paying 2 it is x1A+x2A=4 through the equilibrium E=(3,1) derived in Question 3. The black arrow shows the inward parallel shift. Benjamin receives the transfer and has wealth 4 too.
